description: Cited zoning rules for a covered rural US jurisdiction: district names, setbacks, height, lot area/width, density and coverage from published code sections. Pass district (or zone) or latitude/longitude; with only a jurisdiction you get the available districts and fields. Unpublished fields are UNKNOWN. $0.10 per call in USDC. Verified against official sources and cited to the page; a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged. Per-jurisdiction data dates: see check_coverage.
name: get_zoning
title: Get zoning rules
